name: Keizer
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Keizer, OR 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Keizer, Oregon for 2026: a tree lighting, a lights parade, Glow Oregon and Santa breakfast, with dates and prices checked.
lede: Keizer pairs a chamber-run tree lighting and lights parade with a fire district Santa breakfast and candy cane drive through, plus the Glow Oregon light festival at the ballpark.
celebrates: The Keizer Chamber of Commerce anchors the season with two free community events, the Holiday Tree Lighting at Walery Plaza and the Holiday Lights Parade along River Road, working with the Keizer Fire District and the City of Keizer. The fire district adds its own Santa events at the station on Chemawa Road NE, a pancake breakfast and a drive through candy cane stop. Glow Oregon fills Roto-Rooter Park with lit landmarks, a passport hunt and a Glow Train every night from November 27. The Keizer Community Band closes the calendar with a holiday concert at City Hall.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Keizer's holiday events, so this page leans on the 2026 pages from the chamber, the fire district and Glow Oregon. The chamber calls its parade the city's iconic evening lights parade and describes the tree lighting as a free community event that brings hometown holiday spirit to Walery Plaza, which points to long-running traditions.
facts: Walery Plaza sits at the corner of Cherry Avenue and River Road, and the chamber's tree lighting there invites children 12 and under to enter a drawing to help Santa flip the switch. The Keizer Community Band was formed in 1998 and posts its schedule online. Glow Oregon is held at Roto-Rooter Park on Field of Dreams Way NE, and its 2026 theme, Glow Around the World, includes seven regions and a 40-foot Christmas tree.
trains: Keizer has no holiday train of its own, but Glow Oregon runs a trackless Glow Train through its lit display, and the Oregon Electric Railway Museum and Powerland Heritage Park in Brooks, a short drive away, are listed on our museum guide. Powerland's Holiday Sparkles event is on our Salem page. For more railroad history and a look at vintage trolleys, follow the museum links below.

faq: The Keizer Chamber of Commerce holds a free tree lighting at Walery Plaza and an evening lights parade on River Road. The Keizer Fire District hosts a Santa breakfast and a candy cane drive through at its station, and Glow Oregon lights up Roto-Rooter Park nightly from November 27 through December 31.
Is the Keizer tree lighting free?

Yes. The Keizer Chamber of Commerce calls the Holiday Tree Lighting at Walery Plaza a free community event. Santa arrives with a fire district escort, children 12 and under can enter a drawing to help light the tree, and there are free sandwiches, hot cider and cookies.
Where can kids meet Santa in Keizer?

Kids can meet Santa at the tree lighting, at Breakfast with Santa at the Keizer fire station, at the Candy Cane Drive Through at the same station and at Glow Oregon, where Santa has set hours through December 23. Dates and prices are on each event card.
Is there a Christmas parade in Keizer?

Yes. The Keizer Holiday Lights Parade rolls down River Road in the evening, and floats stage at McNary High School. The chamber suggests bringing chairs, and watching from the roadside is free. The theme this year is Hawaiian Christmas, and the parade starts at 7 pm on Saturday, December 12, 2026.
